bioLead: Carrillo was born in the land of eternal spring and set out on a journey full of challenges in pursuit of his musical dream.
bioSecond: From a very young age, he showed an innate passion for music and an exceptional gift for songwriting. His path, however, was not easy. As he grew up, he faced personal difficulties and surroundings that did not always offer the opportunities he longed for.
bioThird: While searching for work and opportunities, he found his talent and his way forward through music. Today, music is his livelihood, a way to support his family and to carry Guatemala with him from Los Angeles.
bioEnd: An independent artist still building his own path. For his family. For his roots. For everyone who never gave up.
